title: Python Functions
description: A function is a block of code which only runs when it is called.
example:
def my_function():
  print("Hello from a function")

challenges.title: Create Function
challenges.exercise: Define a function named 'my_func' that prints 'Hello'.

challenges.title: Call Function
challenges.exercise: Define 'my_func' to print 'Hi' and then call it.

challenges.title: Arguments
challenges.exercise: Define a function 'greet' that takes a 'name' and prints 'Hello ' + name. Call it with 'Aris'.

challenges.title: Return Value
challenges.exercise: Define a function 'add' that returns x + 5. Print add(10).

challenges.title: Lambda
challenges.exercise: Create a lambda function 'x' that adds 10 to the input and print x(5).
